subject: FinTrust: v5a rollout - high p99 latency and 5xx spike (hotpath impact)
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@fintrust.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, ops@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: v5a rollout causing p99 latency and 500s on payments hotpath

Hi Rishi / Redwood ops team,

We rolled v5a (model+quant profile) to production on our FinTrust integration at 04:45 PDT this morning. Since then, we've seen:
- p99 latency jump from ~180ms -> ~1.1s on the payments hotpath (~20% of requests).
- 5xx rate increase from 0.2% -> 2.8% (majority are 502/504s).
- Throughput degradation: sustained 15% lower RPS served at same client load.

Attached are a short sample of failing request IDs and a 1-hour p99 timeline. We only changed the model variant and used the quant profile recommended in the v5a release notes. This is blocking our peak window.

Can you triage urgently? We need ETA for either a fast rollback or proven mitigation. If this requires a rollback, please advise the activation window and expected client impact.

Thanks,
Asha
Platform Lead, FinTrust

Attachments: fintrust_error_samples.txt, p99-timeline.png, request_ids.csv

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@fintrust.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: v5a rollout causing p99 latency and 500s on payments hotpath

Asha — thanks for the signal and the artifacts, this is on our top of the list.

Immediate plan:
1) Irene and infra will take the lead on triage and attempt a fast rollback to v4alpha on your dedicated pool if that proves safest.
2) We'll open an incident channel (I'll create a Zoom and Slack channel) and keep you updated every 30 minutes during the peak.
3) We will also confirm whether the recommended quant profile shipped with v5a differs from the one validated on your workload.

Irene — can you start looking at the request IDs and the kernel/quant mismatch hypothesis? If rollback is required, please call out exact steps and an ETA; Marissa, please be ready to coordinate any credits/contract remediations.

Rishi
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@fintrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: v5a rollout causing p99 latency and 500s on payments hotpath

Quick triage notes (initial):
- Root cause hypothesis: v5a introduced a new quant profile that increases decode CPU on the first few tokens (we're seeing 1.8-2.4x longer per-token decode in the prefix window). For short hotpath prompts, this pushes total latency into the p99 region and causes some timeouts on our edge proxies.
- Evidence: the request samples show longer cold-KV-cache warmup and decode time; container logs show higher CPU steal at the same token counts.
- 5xx pattern: many 504s originate from the internal inference gateway timing out waiting for response; gateways are not configured to extend for this profile.

Immediate mitigation options:
A) Pin FinTrust pool back to v4alpha (rollback): quick and safe. Expected impact: brief short failover as instances switch (~30-90s per node), restores p99 to baseline.
B) Deploy a compatibility quant profile (v5a-compat) that keeps decode characteristics near v4alpha but preserves some v5a quality improvements — will take 3-4 hours dev+validation on their pool.
C) Adjust gateway timeouts to absorb the longer tail (fast but increases client-perceived latency; not ideal for FinTrust SLAs).

Recommendation: Rollback to v4alpha immediately, run a controlled canary of v5a-compat in parallel. I will prepare the rollback play and add the exact CLI steps in the runbook.

Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/model-rollbacks
Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ops/fintrust-v5a-dashboard

I'll begin rollback prep and will post an ETA for the action within 20 minutes.

— Irene
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@fintrust.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 10:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: v5a rollout causing p99 latency and 500s on payments hotpath

Asha — we're going to proceed with option A (rollback) starting 10:45 PDT after a 15-minute heads-up to your ops team to avoid surprises. Expected timeline:
- 10:45: begin rolling rollback on dedicated pool (rolling by node, 30-90s node conversion).
- 10:55: first canary verification (we'll run health checks and synthetic payloads).
- 11:15: if clean, continue to full roll; we'll closely monitor p99 and 5xx for 30 minutes.

Marissa will coordinate commercial follow-up; we'll also schedule a postmortem and a remediation plan that includes a compatibility quant profile and improved pre-deploy gating for customers on high-SLA hotpaths.

I'll post live updates in the Zoom and share the dashboard.

Rishi

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@fintrust.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@fintrust.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: v5a rollout causing p99 latency and 500s on payments hotpath

Thanks Rishi/Irene — rollback completed and metrics have returned to expected levels during our peak window.

We appreciate the fast response. A few follow-ups from FinTrust:
- Can you confirm the root cause in the postmortem (we need the technical detail for our SRE review)?
- We will request a one-time credit for the incident window (our contracts team asked me to escalate commercially).
- We'd like to be included earlier in future perf validation (can we get a pre-rollout canary in our sandbox for any model/quant changes flagged as "performance-sensitive").

Marissa — please advise next steps for the credit and PM for sandbox canaries.

Asha
Platform Lead, FinTrust
